pin_policy: Every Zagkit release replaces this record with the exact Zag source commit used to build and test it. Branch names and local dirty state are never release identities.
evidence: Zag commit f84b5736b5f8f1f7dd9d4b539d13a2f5ddf9a34b contains the upstream std/list named-owner release repair and the native aggregate-let address-lowering repair required by ZagKit flex and SurfaceV2 code.
The pinned compiler reached a byte-identical self-hosting fixpoint at stage 3; an independent three-generation proof produced SHA-256 c3730aa788728a995657981ecb6bf0f9a5f674d5e72a2da34ff68cbea9b5f274.
The strict v2 named-owner list regression compiles std/list.free under --analyze-strict, executes allocation, growth, readback, named-owner release, and post-release invalidation, and passes.
Semantic conformance passed 16/16 and the native backend passed 135/135, including aggregate call return, local and parameter copy, field copy, and switch-expression aggregate results.
zag-poc/zag.mod at the pinned lineage declares version 2026.07.0-dev and edition 2026.
The pinned lineage provides pure-Zag CRC32, Adler32, deterministic stored-zlib output, and general stored/fixed/dynamic DEFLATE inflate; the same 14-check suite passes on x86-64 and qemu-user ARM64.
